"use strict";
function fib(n) {
  if (n < 2) {
    return n;
  }
  return fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2);
}
function fibIter(n) {
  let a = 0;
  let b = 1;
  {
    let i = 0;
    while (i < n) {
      let next = a + b;
      a = b;
      b = next;
      i = i + 1;
    }
  }
  return a;
}
{
  let i = 0;
  while (i <= 15) {
    console.log(fib(i));
    i = i + 1;
  }
}
console.log(fibIter(40));
